high_level_description: This image is a meme featuring three cartoonish alien characters sitting on a rocky surface with a space-themed background. The aliens have large, round heads and slender bodies. They appear to be engaged in a conversation, as indicated by the speech bubbles above their heads. The left alien asks, "Why earthlings never use telepathy?" while the middle alien responds, "Because they have a lot to hide from each other." The right alien looks on with a neutral expression.
